verdict.rationale: Discord documents a public REST API for interacting with Discord data. It authenticates via bot tokens or OAuth2 bearer tokens and is complemented by a Gateway WebSocket API for events. The docs are also served in agent-friendly form through llms.txt and markdown pages. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Discord API is a REST API that allows you to interact with Discord data from your own applications.
Authenticating with the Discord API can be done in one of two ways: 1. Using a bot token... 2. Using an OAuth2 bearer token
The Gateway API lets apps open secure WebSocket connections with Discord to receive events about actions that take place in a server/guild, like when a channel is updated or a role is created.
